prompt: High-fidelity desktop screenshot mockup, 1600x1000, for GO Itaim's primary “Visão Geral” operations dashboard. Selected Folhas de Operação design direction: warm ivory paper workspace, forest green sidebar and key actions, pale sage filters, graphite text, crisp editorial headings, fine rules, quietly premium operational data sheet; no blue/yellow saturated legacy palette, no glassmorphism, no decorative plants in data area. Browser-free app. Left sidebar with GO Itaim wordmark and exact existing navigation grouped: Principal: Visão Geral selected, Análise, UTR, Comparação; Operacional: Entregadores, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado; Marketing: Operacional Marketing, Marketing; small user profile at bottom. Crucially, above content show a clearly horizontally scrollable city + date ticker with visible left chevron button, four city/date entries Guarulhos · 14/09, Manaus · 15/09, São Paulo 2.0 · 16/09, Sorocaba · 17/09, right chevron button, a visible horizontal scrollbar/thumb and subtle fade to prove more cities are scrollable. Immediately below show the complete global dashboard filter in two clear rows: period mode Ano/Semana selected versus Intervalo, year 2026, multi-select weeks 05, 06, 07; second row Praça Todas, Sub praça Todas, Origem Todas, Turno Todos, Limpar. Main heading “Resumo Operacional”. Three metric cards: Corridas ofertadas 18.450; Aderência 74,8%; Praças 4. Lower section in two columns: “Evolução diária” line chart with Ofertadas and Aceitas; “Por praça” compact table with Guarulhos, Manaus, São Paulo 2.0, Sorocaba and columns Praça/Corridas/Aderência plus total. Ensure ticker and filters occupy visible top viewport and every filter label is legible, intentionally give ticker arrow and scrollbar enough prominence. Fit full page in screenshot. Values and cities illustrative. No watermark.
demoData: Métricas, cidades e datas são ilustrativas.
